name: harnessdesk
description: A community desktop client for DeepSeek Harness
author: HarnessDesk Community

scripts.dev: pnpm run build:bridge && concurrently -k "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist-electron/main/index.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:bridge && pnpm run build:vision && pnpm run build:electron && pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/dsh-desktop-bridge/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/dsh-desktop-vision/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:vision: pnpm run build:vision && node scripts/smoke-vision.mjs test-results/onboarding.png
scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:icons && pnpm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --dir
scripts.package:win: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:icons && pnpm run prepare:runtime -- --platform win32 --arch x64 && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:arm64: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:icons && pnpm run prepare:runtime -- --platform darwin --arch arm64 && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:icons && pnpm run prepare:runtime -- --platform darwin --arch x64 && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
